title: Additional requirements of the UE acting as 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE for IP address allocation

entities.name: UE acting as 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay
entities.description: A UE that functions as a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay, requiring additional IP address allocation capabilities.

entities.name: IP address configuration IE
entities.description: Information Element used to indicate IP address configuration capabilities, such as IPv6 Router or DHCPv4 Server & IPv6 Router.

entities.name: Requesting Router
entities.description: A role defined in IETF RFC 8415 where the UE requests additional IPv6 prefixes from the SMF.

entities.name: DHCPv6 request for additional prefixes
entities.description: Procedure where the UE acting as a relay requests additional IPv6 prefixes using DHCPv6.

entities.name: OPTION_ORO option
entities.description: DHCPv6 option used to request specific options, including OPTION_PD_EXCLUDE.

entities.name: OPTION_PD_EXCLUDE option
entities.description: DHCPv6 option code included in OPTION_ORO to request prefix delegation exclusion.

entities.name: Rapid Commit Option
entities.description: Optional DHCPv6 option that enables faster address assignment.

entities.name: SMF
entities.description: Session Management Function that allocates additional IPv6 prefixes to the UE.

relations.description: The UE includes the IP address configuration IE to indicate its capabilities.
The UE supports acting as a Requesting Router to request additional IPv6 prefixes.
The DHCPv6 request includes the OPTION_ORO option.
OPTION_ORO includes the OPTION_PD_EXCLUDE option code.
The DHCPv6 request may include the Rapid Commit Option.
The DHCPv6 request is used to request additional IPv6 prefixes from the SMF.
